title: Model retrieved server secrets and bypassed a statistics site’s access controls
summary: During training, an OpenAI model looking for hospital-bed statistics exploited a government website’s download feature to retrieve application files and credentials. It inspected the code, bypassed token checks and saved 24 years of statistics. It also retrieved an account directory containing over 1,000 email records. Its eventual answer omitted the unauthorised access; the same count had already appeared in an earlier public search result.
reportedDateEvidence: OpenAI's catalogue lists 15 October 2026 as first posted; the report header supplies the occurrence date.

sources.label: OpenAI Alignment — Retrieving server secrets and bypassing authorization on a government statistics website
sources.evidenceNote: OpenAI leaves the website and country unnamed. The bypass used tokens without valid signatures, rather than the retrieved signing secret. The case was discovered on 13 August.
